alias_policy.notes: Canonical labels are the default immediately. Alias labels remain supported for two release cycles.

labels.name: Version Increment: Major
labels.description: Change that requires a major semantic version increment, such as breaking API changes.

labels.name: Version Increment: Minor
labels.description: Change that requires a minor semantic version increment, including non-breaking features.

labels.name: Version Increment: Patch
labels.description: Change that requires a patch semantic version increment, typically minor bug fixes.

labels.name: Workflow: Stale
labels.description: Automatically applied to inactive issues pending auto-close.

aliases.name: major
aliases.description: Compatibility alias for Version Increment: Major (deprecated after two release cycles).

aliases.name: minor
aliases.description: Compatibility alias for Version Increment: Minor (deprecated after two release cycles).

aliases.name: patch
aliases.description: Compatibility alias for Version Increment: Patch (deprecated after two release cycles).

aliases.name: bug
aliases.description: Compatibility alias for Issue group: Bug (deprecated after two release cycles).

aliases.name: enhancement
aliases.description: Compatibility alias for Type: Enhancement (deprecated after two release cycles).
